item.title: About Me
item.description:
👋 Greetings! I’m Chengtao Liu

I am an undergraduate student at the School of System Design and Intelligent Manufacturing, Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech), majoring in Automation. My research interests lie at the intersection of Robotics, Computer Vision, and Reinforcement Learning, with a focus on building intelligent systems capable of autonomous perception and decision-making in complex environments.

I am a strong proponent of the “Full-stack Engineering” philosophy. From low-level firmware and electromechanical design to high-level perception algorithms and dynamics simulation, I am committed to bridging the gap between theoretical models and physical execution through hands-on system integration.

🎓 Academic & Educational Background

  • Undergraduate: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech) · B.Eng. in Automation
  • IELTS: Overall 6.5 (L: 6.5 / R: 6.5 / W: 6.5 / S: 5.5)
  • Academic Performance: GPA 3.55 / 4.0 (Weighted Average: 86.38/100)
  • Publications: Co-authored the paper “Leveraging LLMs for personalized and manufacturable design generation of multirotor unmanned aerial vehicles,” which has been formally accepted by the 13th CIRP Conference on Manufacturing Systems (CIRPe 2025).

🔍 Core Research & Project Experience

  • Autonomous UAV Systems: Explored LLM-driven automated frame generation and customized manufacturing. Led the redesign of flight control communication protocols and dual-loop PID controller architectures, significantly enhancing flight stability and system scalability.
  • Robotic Perception & Control:
    • Voice-Controlled Robotics: Integrated speech recognition, YOLOv8 object detection, and GRCNN grasp planning to achieve closed-loop automated tool grasping in cluttered environments.
    • Gen3-lite Painting System: Engineered an image-driven painting robot utilizing Jacobian Transpose-based control and force feedback to achieve high-precision trajectory tracking and uniform line strokes.
  • Reinforcement Learning (RL) & Simulation: Deployed PPO algorithms within the Isaac Gym parallel simulation environment. Established a hierarchical training pipeline (Balance - Gait Stability - Terrain Adaptation), enabling bipedal robots to walk adaptively on unstructured terrains such as slopes and gravel.

🏆 Honors & Internships

  • 1st Prize, 2024 National Undergraduate Electronics Design Contest (NUEDC), Guangdong Division.
  • Honorable Mention, 2025 Mathematical Contest in Modeling (MCM/ICM).
  • Internship at Googol Technology (Googoltech): Collaborated on the full-cycle development of a 3-axis PCB drilling system, encompassing electrical integration and precision servo tuning.

🛠️ Technical Toolkit

  • Software & Algorithms: Python, MATLAB, PyTorch, ROS, OpenCV, Simulink
  • Hardware & Control: STM32, TI MSPM0, Arduino, Servo Tuning (DriverStudio), PLC (ST Language)
  • Mechanical Design: SolidWorks, 3D Printing (Bambu Lab), Topology Optimization (Altair Inspire)
